title: ROTTERDAM
1340 TO NOW

cards.title: Rotte + dam
lines: A dam on a small river called the Rotte. Guess where the name comes from.

cards.title: Spanish soldiers
lines: Troops let in through the gate kill townspeople. Rotterdam joins the Dutch Revolt.

cards.title: The Water Town
lines: New harbors are dug inside the walls. Ships moor at the merchants' front doors.

cards.title: Golden Age
lines: Rotterdam helps run the Dutch East India Company, the giant of its age.

cards.title: Two quiet centuries
lines: For 200 years the city barely moves past its medieval walls.

cards.title: Out of the walls
lines: The Water Project: canals, parks and new streets finally break out.

cards.title: A new way to the sea
lines: A straight canal to the North Sea opens. Bigger ships can reach the city.

cards.title: The south bank
lines: A bridge and a railway reach the far side of the river. Docks follow fast.

cards.title: Europe's first skyscraper?
lines: The White House: 43 meters, ten floors. Rotterdam still claims the title.

cards.title: Waalhaven
lines: Once the largest dug harbor basin in the world.

cards.title: City Hall
lines: It opens on the Coolsingel. Remember it: it survives what is coming.

cards.title: Van Nelle Factory
lines: Coffee, tea and tobacco in a glass factory. Today a World Heritage Site.

cards.title: 620,000 people
lines: Rotterdam on the eve of war: crowded, busy, built over six centuries.

cards.title: The center is gone
lines: German bombers strike for 15 minutes. Around 850 people are killed and 80,000 lose their homes.

cards.title: Start from scratch
lines: The ruins are cleared. Rotterdam chooses not to rebuild the old city.

cards.title: The Lijnbaan
lines: One of Europe's first car-free shopping streets.

cards.title: Euromast
lines: Built for a garden show. It still has the best view in town.

cards.title: Underground
lines: The first metro line in the Netherlands opens here.

cards.title: Cube Houses
lines: Piet Blom tilts houses 45 degrees. Residents learn to live with slanted walls.

cards.title: Delftse Poort
lines: 150 meters of glass: for years the tallest building in the Netherlands.

cards.title: Manhattan on the Maas
lines: The old docks of the south bank turn into a forest of towers.

cards.title: De Rotterdam
lines: Three towers, one 'vertical city': the largest building in the Netherlands.
